Here's an example test:

<tool>submit_test(csharp)</tool>
```csharp
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands
{
    public class SuiteCommandTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task ExecuteAsync_InstallsSuite_LogsInformation()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>>();
            var suiteCommand = new SuiteCommand(
                new AbpNuGetIndexUrlService(),
                new PackageVersionCheckerService(),
                new CmdHelper(),
                new AuthService(),
                new CliHttpClientFactory(),
                new SuiteAppSettingsService()
            );
            suiteCommand.Logger = loggerMock.Object;

            // Act
            await suiteCommand.ExecuteAsync(new CommandLineArgs());

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation("ABP Suite has been successfully installed."), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
```
This test creates a mock `ILogger` instance and sets it as the `Logger` property of the `SuiteCommand` instance. It then calls the `ExecuteAsync` method and verifies that the `LogInformation` method is called with the expected message. 

Note that this test assumes that the `ExecuteAsync` method installs the suite and logs the information message. You may need to modify the test to fit your specific use case. 

Also, you will need to install the Moq library in your test project to use this test. You can do this by running the command `dotnet add package Moq` in your terminal.

using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Volo.Abp.DependencyInjection;
using Volo.Abp.Http;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Services
{
    public class AbpNuGetIndexUrlService : IAbpNuGetIndexUrlService, ITransientDependency
    {
        private readonly IAbpCliConfig _cliConfig;

        public AbpNuGetIndexUrlService(IAbpCliConfig cliConfig)
        {
            _cliConfig = cliConfig;
        }

        public async Task<string> GetAsync()

            return await _cliConfig.GetNuGetIndexUrlAsync();

```csharp
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Services;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands
{
    public class SuiteCommandTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task ExecuteAsync_InstallsSuite_LogsInformation()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<SuiteCommand>>();
            var abpNuGetIndexUrlService = new AbpNuGetIndexUrlService(new AbpCliConfig());
            var packageVersionCheckerService = new PackageVersionCheckerService();
            var cmdHelper = new CmdHelper();
            var authService = new AuthService();
            var cliHttpClientFactory = new CliHttpClientFactory();
            var suiteAppSettingsService = new SuiteAppSettingsService();
            var suiteCommand = new SuiteCommand(
                abpNuGetIndexUrlService,
                packageVersionCheckerService,
                cmdHelper,
                authService,
                cliHttpClientFactory,
                suiteAppSettingsService
            );
            suiteCommand.Logger = loggerMock.Object;

            // Act
            await suiteCommand.ExecuteAsync(new CommandLineArgs());

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogInformation("ABP Suite has been successfully installed."), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
```
